text: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizen complying with relevant regulations such as the "Notice of Ministry of Education on Regulating the Work Related to the Admission of International Students by Higher Education Institutions in China" 2. Aged from 18-25 (those who are between 16 and 18 should submit Guardian's Guarantee Statement) 3. Senior high school diploma (or above) 4. In good health 5. For English-taught undergraduate programs: meeting one of the following requirements: native English speaker, or with IELTS band score no less than 5.5, or with TOEFL(ibt) score no less than 60, or passing English test by SUES.
